title: Friend's medium reading channels his late sister

tellings.quote: and he was saying that he saw a medium and the medium immediately started kind of ragging on him the way that his sister did.

plain: A friend of Michels, whom he does not name, went to a medium, a person who claims to speak with the dead, and the medium at once began teasing him the way his late sister used to. Michels tells it as his friend's story in an episode about psychics and the afterlife with a guest named Jeffrey Mishlove. If true, it would suggest the sister was reaching out from beyond death.
